en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural town surrounded by fields and forests. In the foreground are cultivated fields; beyond them lies a cluster of houses and institutional-style buildings among trees. On the right side a tall chimney emits a large plume of dark smoke, and a church tower is visible nearby. Rolling hills and open countryside form the distant background. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
